[[USM Blida]](3 games) |longest unbeaten = [[CRB Aïn Fakroun]] (15 games) |longest losses = [[CR Témouchent]] (9 games) |highest attendance = |lowest attendance = |average attendance = |prevseason = [[2011–12 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2011–12]] |nextseason = [[2013–14 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2|2013–14]] }} The '''2012–13 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2''' was the forty-ninth edition of the Algerian second division since its establishment, and its third season of the league under its current title. A total of 16 teams contested the league. The league started September 14, 2012, and concluded on May 3, 2013. [[CRB Aïn Fakroun]] were crowned champions and promoted to the [[2013–14 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 1]] along with [[RC Arbaâ]] and [[MO Béjaïa]].
